content_html:
12 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories

  • Hiram Boateng charged with affray after pitch invasion incident during York City-Rochdale match Rochdale
    Former MK Dons midfielder Hiram Boateng faces charges following an altercation with a fan during a pitch invasion at a match against Rochdale.
  • Suspected hot tub explosion causes massive fireball in Rochdale Bamford
    A suspected hot tub explosion on Camberley Drive in Rochdale sent debris flying and prompted a major emergency response, but no injuries were reported.
  • Heywood homes left without power after cable fault during snow warning Heywood
    Sixty-five properties in north Heywood lost power on Tuesday morning, with engineers aiming to restore supplies by 12.30pm.
  • Rochdale Borough Council awards £4.8 million health improvement contract Rochdale
    The Big Life Company Limited has been awarded a contract to provide health improvement services in Rochdale, valued at £4.8 million.
  • Rochdale Borough Active Awards 2026 celebrate community champions Middleton
    The Rochdale Borough Active Awards 2026 took place at Middleton Arena, recognising the contributions of local coaches, volunteers, and young athletes.
  • LIVE: No injuries reported after suspected gas explosion at Bamford house as emergency services remain Bamford
    Police and the fire service say no injuries have been reported after a suspected gas explosion at a house in Bamford at around 4.30pm. Bury Road is closed from Midgehall Drive to Woodtop Avenue.
  • Former Clean Air Zone cameras now used by police to fight crime across Greater Manchester Rochdale
    Around 400 number plate cameras put up for the scrapped Clean Air Zone have been handed to Greater Manchester Police, with a senior officer saying they have led to multiple arrests.
  • Rochdale teenagers born in 2009 or later will never be legally sold tobacco from 1 January Rochdale
    The generational smoking ban starts on 1 January 2027, making it an offence to sell tobacco to anyone born on or after 1 January 2009.
  • Rochdale Council unveils £5.6m plan to improve temporary accommodation for homeless families Rochdale
    The council's new framework aims to enhance the quality and cost-effectiveness of temporary housing for vulnerable families in Rochdale.
  • Husband-and-wife pottery studio expands in Rochdale town centre Rochdale
    Clay & Glaze, a pottery painting studio in Rochdale, has grown from two to five staff in just over a year, receiving recognition at local business awards.
  • Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood Heywood
    Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.
  • Littleborough Brass Bands Association Christmas Concert Littleborough
    Join Littleborough Brass Bands Association for a festive evening of Christmas favourites, featuring all three bands. Great music, seasonal cheer and a licensed bar!

Weather: Light rain 7°C in Rochdale today.

The Morning Briefing is published every day at 9am. Got a story? Tell the newsdesk.
body:
12 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Hiram Boateng charged with affray after pitch invasion incident during York City-Rochdale match (Rochdale). Former MK Dons midfielder Hiram Boateng faces charges following an altercation with a fan during a pitch invasion at a match against Rochdale.

Suspected hot tub explosion causes massive fireball in Rochdale (Bamford). A suspected hot tub explosion on Camberley Drive in Rochdale sent debris flying and prompted a major emergency response, but no injuries were reported.

Heywood homes left without power after cable fault during snow warning (Heywood). Sixty-five properties in north Heywood lost power on Tuesday morning, with engineers aiming to restore supplies by 12.30pm.

Rochdale Borough Council awards £4.8 million health improvement contract (Rochdale). The Big Life Company Limited has been awarded a contract to provide health improvement services in Rochdale, valued at £4.8 million.

Rochdale Borough Active Awards 2026 celebrate community champions (Middleton). The Rochdale Borough Active Awards 2026 took place at Middleton Arena, recognising the contributions of local coaches, volunteers, and young athletes.

LIVE: No injuries reported after suspected gas explosion at Bamford house as emergency services remain (Bamford). Police and the fire service say no injuries have been reported after a suspected gas explosion at a house in Bamford at around 4.30pm. Bury Road is closed from Midgehall Drive to Woodtop Avenue.

Former Clean Air Zone cameras now used by police to fight crime across Greater Manchester (Rochdale). Around 400 number plate cameras put up for the scrapped Clean Air Zone have been handed to Greater Manchester Police, with a senior officer saying they have led to multiple arrests.

Rochdale teenagers born in 2009 or later will never be legally sold tobacco from 1 January (Rochdale). The generational smoking ban starts on 1 January 2027, making it an offence to sell tobacco to anyone born on or after 1 January 2009.

Rochdale Council unveils £5.6m plan to improve temporary accommodation for homeless families (Rochdale). The council's new framework aims to enhance the quality and cost-effectiveness of temporary housing for vulnerable families in Rochdale.

Husband-and-wife pottery studio expands in Rochdale town centre (Rochdale). Clay & Glaze, a pottery painting studio in Rochdale, has grown from two to five staff in just over a year, receiving recognition at local business awards.

Breakfast with Santa at Queen's Park Café, Heywood (Heywood). Queen's Park Café in Heywood is hosting Breakfast with Santa on six mornings between Saturday 12 and Wednesday 23 December, each running from 10.30am to 12pm.

Littleborough Brass Bands Association Christmas Concert (Littleborough). Join Littleborough Brass Bands Association for a festive evening of Christmas favourites, featuring all three bands. Great music, seasonal cheer and a licensed bar!

Weather: Light rain 7°C in Rochdale today.
